historyPolicy: Path-filtered native-only history imported with original authorship. No remote, game art or game integration. Host source retained until consumer cutover.
parentFolderMetadata: Archived outside Unity: multiple UPM packages replace one former parent folder; no active duplicate GUID.

files.adaptation: Serialize feature metadata with explicit JSON tokens for native AOT hosts, preserving the versioned wire format.

neutralFixture.generation: Captured from the same neutral compiler fixture used by the Host ownership baseline; compiler extraction is a separate stage.

publicationPolicy: Historical paths and comments use neutral host terminology; commit subjects omit unsupported tracker scopes. Runtime binaries, carrier, SDK, GUIDs and public APIs are preserved.
